answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh mirror challenge every epoch. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the delta of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the vine behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 1pnj5.
